updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP Upgraded Inline Protection for Entra-Managed Apps in Edge for Business
updates.summary: Microsoft Purview is enhancing inline data loss prevention for Entra-managed applications in Edge for Business by integrating with Conditional Access grant controls and expanding policy capabilities. Admins gain access to more granular conditions, multiple activities per rule, simulation mode, and improved visibility into rule matches through activity explorer.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP Expanded Inline Protection for Unmanaged Apps in Edge for Business
updates.summary: Purview DLP policies now extend browser-based inline protection to a significantly broader set of unmanaged generative AI applications in Edge for Business, allowing consistent data security enforcement across more destinations. Admins can detect and prevent sensitive data sharing through existing policy experiences without requiring separate configurations.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint DLP Support for Copilot + PC Recall Snapshots
updates.summary: Endpoint DLP now protects Copilot + PC devices by preventing capture of windows containing restricted sensitivity labels and sensitive information types through Recall snapshots via custom policies. Purview admins can author endpoint DLP policies that integrate with Intune-managed Recall configuration for comprehensive device-level protection.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint DLP Protection in Excluded Windows Folders
updates.summary: Endpoint DLP is expanding coverage to protect sensitive files stored in commonly excluded Windows directories such as Temp and AppData folders. This enhancement improves overall data protection coverage by closing gaps where sensitive data might previously have been overlooked.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint DLP Just-In-Time Audit User and Group Scoping
updates.summary: Admins can now selectively include or exclude specific users and user groups from Just-In-Time (JIT) audit generation in Endpoint DLP. This granular scoping capability reduces audit noise and ensures compliance reviews focus on the most relevant personnel.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint DLP Archive File Classification Behavior Change
updates.summary: Archive file classification behavior on Windows endpoints is being updated to align with cloud workload handling, improving consistency and reducing event reporting noise. This change enhances performance and provides a unified experience across deployment platforms.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DSPM Copilot Readiness and Data Explorer
updates.summary: Purview Data Security Posture Management introduces new readiness assessments for Copilot and an enhanced data explorer to help security teams evaluate data exposure, oversharing, and protection coverage. These insights enable organizations to assess and improve their security posture for Copilot adoption.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Unified Classification Management Experience
updates.summary: Purview now consolidates all classifiers—Sensitive Information Types, Exact Data Match, fingerprint SITs, and trainable classifiers—into a single unified interface. This streamlines classifier discovery, creation, validation, and management for compliance and security teams.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management for Departed Employees
updates.summary: Purview now enables admins to automatically delete both content and containers (OneDrives and mailboxes) for departed users at scale, reducing manual compliance overhead. This capability helps organizations maintain regulatory compliance and manage inactive user resources efficiently.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Retention Based on Last Accessed in OneDrive and SharePoint
updates.summary: Admins can now apply retention labels and policies to OneDrive and SharePoint items based on when files were last accessed by users, enabling more intelligent data lifecycle management. This capability helps reduce storage costs and improve compliance by targeting inactive content.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management Sensitive Data Insights and Policy Recommendations
updates.summary: Purview now provides insights and retention policy recommendations based on sensitive data detected in OneDrive and SharePoint, helping admins make informed decisions about data governance. These recommendations improve compliance posture by highlighting where retention policies should be applied.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: DLP for Non-Microsoft Connected Apps (Box, Google Workspace)
updates.summary: Purview DLP now supports creating and enforcing data loss prevention policies for non-Microsoft connected applications such as Box and Google Workspace using existing Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps connectors. This extends consistent classification and protection across multi-cloud environments.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint DLP macOS 27 Permission Changes Preparation
updates.summary: Endpoint DLP administrators should deploy client version 101.26072 or later and configure protection modes to prepare for upcoming permission changes in macOS 27. This proactive step ensures Device Control and Data Access permissions remain properly configured and users are notified of any required actions.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Inactive Mailbox 30-Day Delay Hold Automatically Applied
updates.summary: When the last hold is removed from an inactive mailbox, Microsoft 365 now automatically applies a 30-day delay hold to protect against accidental deletion. Admins should review guidance on identifying and removing delay holds before recalculating mailbox hold status.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Priority Cleanup for Permanent File Deletion in SharePoint and OneDrive
updates.summary: Purview Data Lifecycle Management now offers Priority Cleanup to permanently delete selected SharePoint and OneDrive files, bypassing recycle bins and removing them from search. After simulation, review, and required approvals, this capability provides faster, more permanent cleanup of sensitive or unnecessary data.
